def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Try: recolored iff cell lies ON an anti-diagonal or main diagonal containing exactly TWO seeds (the minimal set covering), i.e. the LINE through two specific seeds, extended. Also test: recolored iff cell NOT such a line. Print per line-type accuracy & fraction recolored of qualifying lines.
for n,bgc,sev in [(7,6,1),(8,4,2)]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
    rec=(O==5)&(I!=sev); R,C_=rec.shape
    S=list(map(tuple,np.argwhere(I==sev)))
    tot=sum(1 for i in range(R) for j in range(C_) if I[i][j]==bgc)
    # collect unique line constants from all ordered pairs (rows, cols, main diags, anti diags) - use canonical key
    L=set()
    for a,c in itertools.combinations(S,2):
        da,dc=c[0]-a[0],c[1]-a[1]
        g=int(np.gcd(abs(da),abs(dc)))
        if g: L.add(((da//g,dc//g),(a[0]*dc//g-c[0]*dc//g)//1))  # placeholder; just store direction+anchor properly below

    # mode 'line': cell belongs to infinite line through some pair (any slope). mode 'exactly2onmainoranti': same but only exact diag/row/col
    def f_any_slope(i,j):
        for a in S:
            for c in S:
                if a==c: continue
                if (i-a[0])*(c[1]-a[1])==(j-a[1])*(c[0]-a[0]): return True
        return False
    def f_exactdiag(i,j):
        fr=sum(1 for s in S if s[0]==i); fc=sum(1 for s in S if s[1]==j)
        fd=sum(1 for s in S if s[0]-s[1]==i-j); fa=sum(1 for s in S if s[0]+s[1]==i+j)
        return fr>=2 or fc>=2 or fd>=2 or fa>=2
    print('demo',n,'any-slope-infinite:',round(acc(f_any_slope,'any'),3),'exactdiag:',round(acc(f_exactdiag,'exact'),3))
